items.title: LangSuggest
items.text: LangSuggest is a language suggest plugin for MODX Revolution that is meant to be used with Babel. It displays a popup (or something different at the start or the end of the html body tag), that could redirect the browser to the preferred language context, when the current context does not contain a browser accepted language.

items.title: Requirements
items.text:
• MODX Revolution 2.7+
  • PHP 7.3+

items.title: Features
items.text:
• Show a redirect link to a language context with a browser accepted language
  • The content of the popup/bar can be changed by the system settings

items.title: Install from MODX Extras
items.text: Search for LangSuggest in the Package Manager of your MODX installation and install it in there.

items.title: Manual installation
items.text:
If you can't access the MODX Extras Repository in your MODX installation, you can manually install LangSuggest.

  • Download the transport package from MODX Extras (or one of the pre built transport packages in _packages)
  • Upload the zip file to your MODX installation's core/packages folder or upload it manually in the MODX Package Manager.
  • In the MODX Manager, navigate to the Package Manager page, and select 'Search locally for packages' from the dropdown button.
  • LangSuggest should now show up in the list of available packages. Click the corresponding 'Install' button and follow the instructions to complete the installation.

items.title: Build it from source
items.text: To build and install the package from source you could use Git Package Management. The GitHub repository of LangSuggest contains a config.json to build that package locally. Use this option, if you want to debug LangSuggest and/or contribute bugfixes and enhancements.

items.title: Usage
items.text:

items.title: How it works
items.text:
LangSuggest needs Babel and uses the contexts listed in the babel.contextKeys system setting. Each of these contexts needs a cultureKey context setting. Additional language codes for a context can be set with a comma separated cultureKeyAliases context setting.

On each rendered page, the plugin compares the browser accepted languages (the Accept-Language header, sorted by q factor) with the culture keys of the Babel contexts:

  1. An exact match wins, i.e. pt-BR matches a context with the culture key pt-br.
  2. Otherwise the base language matches, i.e. pt-BR matches a context with the culture key pt-pt. If several contexts share that base language, the one that the browser requests explicitly is preferred, then the plain base language, then the first one.
  3. If no browser language matches, the context in the babel.contextDefault system setting is used.

If the detected context is not the current context, the LangSuggest chunk is added to the page and the body tag gets the langsuggestActive class, that can be used for styling.

LangSuggest is not shown, if the visitor has the LangSuggest cookie (it is set when the language is switched with the button in the chunk) or if the display count of the session is used up. In session-less contexts, LangSuggest is only shown, if the Session-less Contexts system setting is enabled. The display count is not used in that case.

The culture keys of the Babel contexts are cached. Clear the MODX cache, after the contexts or their culture keys were changed.

items.title: Reset
items.text: Add langsuggest_reset=1 to the URL of a page to remove the LangSuggest cookie and reset the display count of the current session. This is useful for testing.

items.title: Chunks and placeholder
items.text:
Two sample chunks are available that can be duplicated, renamed, and referenced in the system settings: tplLangSuggestBar and tplLangSuggestModal.

tplLangSuggestModal will display a modal window (a native HTML dialog element with Bootstrap 3 class names), that suggests to redirect to the translation of the current resource in the preferred language of the visitor. tplLangSuggestBar will display a Bootstrap 3 styled bar with a language select box, that is filled by the BabelLinks snippet and uses the tplLangSuggestBarOption chunk for the options.

Both sample chunks use plain JavaScript and don't require jQuery or the Bootstrap JavaScript. The modal chunk contains some basic styles and uses the Bootstrap 3 button styles, if they are available. When the visitor switches the language with the button in the chunk, a cookie is set, that hides LangSuggest for the configured cookie expiration. A cookie expiration of 0 creates a session cookie. Closing the chunk (with the close button, the no button, the Esc key or a click on the modal backdrop) does not set the cookie. In that case, LangSuggest is shown again on the next page, until the display count of the session is used up.

The following placeholders are available in the chunk:

Key Description cookie_expiration The expiration of the cookie in days. The cookie is set, when the visitor switches the language with the button. cookie_name The name of the cookie, that hides LangSuggest. The cookie is set, when the language is switched with the button. cultureKey The culture key of the context with the preferred browser accepted language. current_id The id of the current resource. debug The value of the debug system setting. redirect_id The id of the Babel translation of the current resource in the preferred context or the site start of that context.

items.title: System Settings
items.text:
LangSuggest uses the following system settings in the namespace langsuggest:

Key Name Description Default langsuggest.chunk_position Chunk Position The position of the LangSuggest chunk output in the body section of the rendered page. Can be set to top or bottom. bottom langsuggest.cookie_expiration Cookie Expiration The number of days LangSuggest stays hidden after the language was switched with its button. 0 creates a session cookie. 365 langsuggest.cookie_name Cookie Name The name of the cookie that is set by LangSuggest, when the language should be switched. Characters other than letters, digits, _ and - are replaced with _. LangSuggest langsuggest.debug Debug Log debug information in the MODX error log. No langsuggest.display_count Display Count Maximum display count of LangSuggest modal for each session, if a PHP session exists. 3 langsuggest.no_session Session-less Contexts Show LangSuggest on session-less contexts. No langsuggest.tpl Modal Template The template chunk containing the LangSuggest modal. tplLangSuggestModal
